8.3.4 StbM_GetCurrentSafeTime
[SWS_StbM_91027] Definition of API function StbM_GetCurrentSafeTime
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_00005, RS_TS_00006, RS_TS_00029, RS_TS_00030, RS_-
TS_00031, RS_TS_00014
⌈
Service Name
StbM_GetCurrentSafeTime (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType StbM_GetCurrentSafeTime (
StbM_SynchronizedTimeBaseType timeBaseId,
StbM_TimeTripleType* timeTriple,
StbM_UserDataType* userData
)
Service ID [hex]
0x30
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
timeBaseId
time base reference
Parameters (inout)
None
timeTriple
Current time triple values (Current time , Current fallback time,
and global time)
Parameters (out)
userData
User data of the Time Base
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: successful
E_NOT_OK: failed
Description
Returns a time triple (Local Time, Fallback Local Time, Global time and timebase status) and
user data details. Note: This API shall be called with locked interrupts / within an Exclusive
Area to prevent interruption (i.e., the risk that the time stamp is outdated on return of the
function call).
Tags: atp.Status=draft
▽
△
Available via
StbM.h
⌋
[SWS_StbM_00598]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_GetCurrentSafeTime
shall report to DET the development error STBM_E_PARAM, if called with a parameter
timeBaseId, which is
• not configured or
• within the reserved value range.
